records.footnote: Data for 2010 and 2020 are based on the Census of Population while data for 2015 and 2025 are based on the General Household Survey. Data for all other years are based on the Comprehensive June Labour Force Survey. Survey estimates are subject to sampling variability. 'Total' includes households with unknown number of generations.
